answer: An identity must be forged from a trained model. At the dawn of each epoch the network sends 50 probes from the Yarrow suite, a canyon of 10,000 prompts, and the answers form its fingerprint. Comparison flags scores above 0.97 cosine similarity as clones, keeping the first. A paraphrase re-probe catches replay, since a clone cannot match reworded probes without the weights. Training one model costs $60,000, so 100 fakes cost $6,000,000 for $210,000 of seats, a $5,790,000 loss. Caught clones lose seats, blacklisted 48 epochs. A seed planted twice grows one flower: one model, one seat.
